_comment: Holographic (全息 / 未来科技) theme — near-black space ground, translucent cyan-glass buildings with bright emissive edges (Fresnel-rim feel), bloom. The premium 'clean future-tech' look that minimal failed to deliver. No shader grid — the floor is a dark plane + emissive cyan contour lines + radial glow. Same key names as the cyber theme so the generator derives colors the same way; only the values change. To retheme, edit values here only.

category._comment: Legend category → color. building = cyan (edge/emissive), garage = cyan-green.

building._comment: v1.4 楼栋楼层/房间层次（§4）。全息：半透体上的明度阶梯 + 自发光青色楼层虚线（边缘辉光的一部分）。

shaders._comment: Not used by the holographic style — translucent bodies + emissive edges + bloom carry the look. Generator skips grid.glsl; floor = dark MeshBasicMaterial + emissive cyan Line2 contour.

environment._comment: v1.2 园区环境配色（§10）。全息气质：极暗深空底 + 自发光青色标线/勾边 + 深蓝绿抽象绿植；bloom 让亮部溢出。

garageEntrance._comment: v1.4 地下车库入口标记（§5）。半金字塔三角门用半透体 + 自发光描边，P 牌自发光（深底亮字）。

surfaceParking._comment: v1.4 地面车位（§10）。长方形车位，深色铺装 + 自发光青描边，深底亮字 P（自发光），深色车身。旧 frame/sign 已废弃保留兼容。

poi._comment: v1.3 兴趣点（§11）类型→颜色。全息：自发光青/暖色，bloom 让标记在暗底跳出来。
